title: Generic evidence rubric (fallback)

rubric.0: No relevant evidence in the answer.
rubric.1: Relevant but vague or generic; no personal contribution or specifics.
rubric.2: Specific example with the candidate's own actions.
rubric.3: Specific example with own actions, measurable outcome and trade-offs considered.

note: Used only when no reviewed question record exists for a required skill; the plan then lists the gap in missing_information.
